Thanks for the detailed report. This is an automated hermes-sweeper review; the reported Ollama Cloud routing issue is already fixed on main and shipped in v2026.5.28 (Hermes Agent v0.15.0).

- `43802ef3e37826af8fb67b98208051aea916a48a` added the Ollama Cloud default endpoint `https://ollama.com/v1`.
- Current `hermes_cli/providers.py:204-207` retains that OpenAI-compatible `/v1` routing, avoiding the reported `/api/chat/completions` 404.
- `tests/hermes_cli/test_ollama_cloud_provider.py:95-102` verifies that `ollama-cloud` resolves to `chat_completions` at `https://ollama.com/v1`.

Please update to v2026.5.28 or later and reconfigure/select the built-in `ollama-cloud` provider if the older `/api` endpoint remains in local configuration.
